tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Tonight, escape the mundane with "The Odyssey," a timeless epic that proves even ancient kings had terrible travel agents and an insatiable knack for pissing off deities. It's a grand spectacle of monsters, gods, and a hero just trying to get home, offering a perfect blend of adventure and classical drama.

releases.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
releases.take: Before Katniss, there was another Quarter Quell, proving Panem's favorite pastime is still child-on-child gladiatorial combat with extra steps.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: Three universes collide, because apparently, one apocalypse wasn't enough to keep these heroes busy.

releases.title: Steps
releases.take: This isn't your grandma's Cinderella story; it's a magical mishap where the stepsister finally gets to be the hero, albeit an amphibian-cursing one.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: Forget Air Force One; "The Beast" delivers a no-holds-barred action thrill ride where the President's limousine is the last line of defense against a full-blown coup. It's high-octane escapism with a presidential twist, perfect for those who like their Oval Office dramas with a side of explosive vehicular combat.
